title: Newspaper clipping
about: A column cut from a newspaper: yellowed newsprint, a masthead and dateline, torn top and bottom, lying on a desk.

fields.prop_masthead: The paper's name, printed above the column on the first sheet, e.g. The Arkham Advertiser
fields.prop_dateline: The date line under the masthead, e.g. Tuesday, 4 March 1924
